options.content: **Symptom** (burn-rate alert) → **Correlator** (`/webhook/alertmanager`) → **Evidence** (Prometheus / Tempo / Loki / K8s / GitOps) → **Ranked hypothesis + runbook** → **Human verdict** (`PATCH /incidents/{id}/verdict`).

panels.title: Correlator incidents (query API manually or use Infinity datasource)
